LONG BEACH CONTINUUM OF CARE AGENDA
  TUESDAY, OCTOBER 13, 2026
  1500 HUGHES WAY STE. C-300 LONG BEACH, CA 90810
  HOUSING AUTHORITY, 12:30 PM

Tamika Boyce, Co-Chair  Jacob Muñoz, Member
Claude Diles III, Co-Chair  Steven Rockenbach, Member
Nikki Amick, Member  Patricia Scott, Member
Brandi Brown-Shock, Member  Jamies Shuford, Member
Connor Lock, Member  Aiko Tan, Member
Melanie Martins, Member  Anna Topolewski, Member
Hawk McFadzen, Member  Kimberly Wee, Member

  SPECIAL MEETING

  Members of the public have the option to email public comments
  to homelessservicesadmin@longbeach.gov

  For information on how to participate in this meeting, please visit:
  https://www.longbeach.gov/homelessness/volunteer-donate-and-get-involved/#committee

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  26-56354  Recommendation to introduce City staff and Long Beach Continuum of Care Board
  members and conduct a capacity-building activity to enhance Board engagement:
  "Working Together to Strengthen Our System".

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  26-56211  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation from the Ethics Department
  and the City Attorney’s Office on the 2026 Annual Ethics Update, including the
  Brown Act and Robert’s Rules of Order.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  26-56213  Recommendation to receive and file a report on Long Beach Continuum of Care
  (CoC) Board member attendance and compliance with attendance requirements.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  26-56214  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation on the results of the 2026 Long
  Beach Homeless Count.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  26-56215  Recommendation to receive and file an update on the recruitment and selection
  process for new Long Beach Continuum of Care (CoC) Board members.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

6.  26-56216  Recommendation to discuss and approve the Long Beach Continuum of Care
  (CoC) Board committee structure and appointment process; establish and approve
  the Budget and Finance Committee and the Youth Advisory Board with Lived
  Experience; and approve committee chairs for the Access Committee, Coordinated
  Entry System (CES) Committee, Stabilization Committee, and UFA Budget and
  Finance Committee.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

7.  26-56218  Recommendation to receive and file an update on the FY 2026 Continuum of Care
  (CoC) Program Notice of Funding Opportunity (NOFO) Competition.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

8.  26-56219  Recommendation to receive and file an update on funding impacting the Long
  Beach homeless response system.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Long Beach Continuum of Care on non-agenda items. Each speaker is
limited to two minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Co-Chairs.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Jennifer Santana, Community Program Specialist III, certify that the agenda was posted not less
than 72 hours prior to the meeting.

Santana at 562-570-4555 by 12 noon, the day prior to the meeting.
